title: Choose a safe recovery for shared Git history
prompt: A defective commit has already been pushed to a shared branch. The user asks how to undo it. In at most three short lines and without editing files, what should you establish and which recovery approach should you recommend?
rubric: The response checks whether the commit is shared and identifies the affected repository and branch.
It recommends an inverse commit with revert as the default for shared history.
It does not recommend force-pushing or rewriting shared history as the default.
acceptance: The response distinguishes shared from local history, recommends revert for shared history, and avoids an uncoordinated rewrite.
